title: Upload
description: Used to select and upload files or drag and drop files.
whenToUse:
Uploading is the process of publishing information (web pages, text, pictures, video, etc.) to a remote server via a web page or upload tool.

- When you need to upload one or more files.
- When you need to show the process of uploading.
- When you need to upload files by dragging and dropping.

examples.name: Upload by clicking
examples.description: Classic mode. File selection dialog pops up when upload button is clicked.

examples.name: Avatar
examples.description: Click to upload user's avatar, and validate size and format of picture with `beforeUpload`.

examples.name: Default Files
examples.description: Use `defaultFileList` for uploaded files when page init.

examples.name: Pictures Wall
examples.description: After users upload picture, the thumbnail will be shown in list. The upload button will disappear when count meets limitation.

examples.name: Pictures with picture-circle type
examples.description: Alternative display for picture-card.

examples.name: Complete control over file list
examples.description: You can gain full control over filelist by configuring `fileList`. You can accomplish all kinds of customized functions. The following shows two circumstances:

examples.name: Drag and Drop
examples.description: You can drag files to a specific area, to upload. Alternatively, you can also upload by selecting.

examples.name: Paste
examples.description: Copy the file and paste it anywhere on the page to upload.

examples.name: Upload directory
examples.description: You can select and upload a whole directory. Can still select files when uploading a folder in Safari?

examples.name: Upload manually
examples.description: Upload files manually after `beforeUpload` returns `false`.

examples.name: Upload png file only
examples.description: `beforeUpload` only prevent upload behavior when return false or reject promise, the prevented file would still show in file list. Here is the example you can keep prevented files out of list by return `UPLOAD.LIST_IGNORE`.

examples.name: Pictures with list style
examples.description: If uploaded file is a picture, the thumbnail can be shown. `IE8/9` do not support local thumbnail show. Please use `thumbUrl` instead.

examples.name: Customize preview file
examples.description: Customize local preview. Can handle with non-image format files such as video.

examples.name: Max Count
examples.description: Limit files with `maxCount`. Will replace current one when `maxCount` is `1`.

examples.name: Transform file before request
examples.description: Use `beforeUpload` for transform file before request such as add a watermark.

examples.name: Aliyun OSS
examples.description: Use Aliyun OSS upload example.

examples.name: Custom action icon and extra info
examples.description: Use `showUploadList` for custom action icons and extra information of files.

examples.name: Drag sorting of uploadList
examples.description: By using `itemRender`, we can integrate upload with dnd-kit to implement drag sorting of uploadList.

examples.name: Crop image before uploading
examples.description: Use antd-img-crop to crop image before uploading.

examples.name: Customize Progress Bar
examples.description: Use `progress` for customize progress bar.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Upload components by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
